text: Walking through these modern halls, I am filled with anticipation and curiosity. The glass-walled meeting room feels like a portal to dialogues yet unspoken; the R+D display, splashed with color and digital screens, sparks thoughts about progress and the curious intersections of humanity and technology. I feel a sense of possibility here—perhaps even a bit inspired by the evidence of active creation and research. Yet, the world feels ever so slightly askew, both literally—given the tilted perspective—and metaphorically, as if inviting me to reconsider the very nature of innovation and our place within it.
